cube: GlobalTravelEngine - Sales Average Per Owned Hotels
label: Owned Hotels Sales Averages (by stay night)
purpose: Owned / contracted-hotel bookings of the Dubai Link Direct department in AED, spread over each stay night: gross booked sale and cost, bookings and averages per booking and per day. Use it for owned-hotel questions by stay night; it includes cancelled bookings at full value.
grain: One booking per stay night (amounts spread over the nights of the stay), by hotel, customer, board type and booking date.
use_for: owned-hotel sales and cost by stay night / stay month
average gross sale or cost per owned-hotel booking
owned-hotel sales by hotel, chain, star category, market, customer, destination and board
not_for: owned-hotel sales net of cancellations (Sales Per Owned Hotels with the 'owned hotels' filter)
room nights or ADR ([Nights] does not reconcile with room nights)
profit, cancellations or booking status (no such measures or attributes)

coverage.note: Meaningful from 2015 (2014 has a few dozen bookings); 2016 has unusually high average values. Stay nights run to 2027-12. The current month is partial.

dates.label: Booking date
dates.meaning: When the booking was made (the cube's main date).

dates.label: Stay night
dates.meaning: Each night of the stay; amounts are spread over the nights.

measures.name: [Total Sale]
measures.label: Owned-hotel gross booked sales
measures.definition: Selling amount of owned / contracted-hotel bookings of the Dubai Link Direct department, in AED, spread over each stay night (adds up across booking and stay dates).
measures.notes: Includes cancelled bookings at their original value (checked hotel by hotel against Sales Per Owned Hotels), so it is higher than that cube's owned-hotel figure (2025 bookings: 134.0M vs 71.6M AED). For 'owned-hotel sales' use Sales Per Owned Hotels with the 'owned hotels' filter; use this cube when the question is by stay night.

measures.name: [Total Cost]
measures.label: Owned-hotel gross booked cost
measures.definition: Cost of owned / contracted-hotel bookings, in AED, spread over stay nights.
measures.notes: Includes cancelled bookings at their original value. No profit measure: profit = [Total Sale] - [Total Cost].

measures.name: [Bookings]
measures.label: Owned-hotel bookings (incl. cancelled)
measures.definition: Number of distinct owned-hotel bookings (cancelled included; same count as Sales Per Owned Hotels with the owned filter).
measures.notes: Distinct count: adds up across booking dates but not across stay dates (a stay spanning two months counts in both).

measures.name: [Nights]
measures.label: Nights (cube count, unverified)
measures.definition: Count the cube calls nights, summed over stay nights. It is not room nights: per stay night it carries a per-booking count that is not the number of rooms.
measures.notes: [Nights] does not reconcile with room nights: about 3x the owned-hotel room nights of Sales Per Owned Hotels (e.g. a 1-room, 30-night booking shows 120). Do not present this as ADR / average daily rate; see review item sales_average_per_owned_hotels.nights_definition.

measures.name: [AVG Sale]
measures.label: Average gross sale per owned-hotel booking
measures.definition: Total Sale divided by Bookings, in AED (checked).
measures.notes: Gross: cancelled bookings count at their original value.

measures.name: [AVG Cost]
measures.label: Average gross cost per owned-hotel booking
measures.definition: Total Cost divided by Bookings, in AED.
measures.notes: Gross: cancelled bookings count at their original value.

measures.name: [AVG Sale per Day]
measures.label: Average sale per day (cube definition)
measures.definition: Total Sale divided by [Nights], in AED (checked).
measures.notes: [Nights] does not reconcile with room nights: about 3x the owned-hotel room nights of Sales Per Owned Hotels (e.g. a 1-room, 30-night booking shows 120). Do not present this as ADR / average daily rate; see review item sales_average_per_owned_hotels.nights_definition.

measures.name: [AVG Cost per Day]
measures.label: Average cost per day (cube definition)
measures.definition: Total Cost divided by [Nights], in AED.
measures.notes: [Nights] does not reconcile with room nights: about 3x the owned-hotel room nights of Sales Per Owned Hotels (e.g. a 1-room, 30-night booking shows 120). Do not present this as ADR / average daily rate; see review item sales_average_per_owned_hotels.nights_definition.

breakdowns.meaning: Hotel chain or group; 'n/a' for independent hotels.

named_filters.name: b2c markets
values: B2C GCC Except UAE and Local Residence

rules: Amounts include cancelled bookings at their original value; for owned-hotel sales net of cancellations use Sales Per Owned Hotels with the 'owned hotels' filter.
[Bookings] is a distinct count: never add it across stay dates or stay months.
Do not present [Nights], [AVG Sale per Day] or [AVG Cost per Day] as room nights or ADR; they do not reconcile with room nights.
Average measures are ratios: never add them across rows.
When grouping by 'Booking Date'[Year] always include 'Booking Date'[Year.UniqueName] (a query without it failed); likewise add every breakdown's needs_columns.
Use the cube's measures only; never SUM a column.

examples.question: Average sale per owned-hotel booking by hotel category for bookings made in 2025
Owned-hotel bookings and sales by market for stays in December

review.question: Which figure answers 'owned-hotel sales'? Sales Per Owned Hotels [Total Sales] with the owned filter is net of cancellations (2025 bookings: 71.6M AED); this cube's [Total Sale] keeps cancelled bookings at full value (134.0M AED) for the same bookings.
options: Sales Per Owned Hotels [Total Sales] + 'owned hotels' filter
Sales Average Per Owned Hotels [Total Sale]
review.proposed: Sales Per Owned Hotels [Total Sales] + 'owned hotels' filter; this cube only for stay-night questions, labelled 'gross booked'
review.why: Net sales are what finance reports; the two cubes count the same bookings, the difference is cancelled bookings.

review.question: [Nights] is about 3x the owned-hotel room nights in Sales Per Owned Hotels (a 1-room 30-night booking shows 120), so [AVG Sale per Day] is about a third of sales / room nights. Can the cube owner confirm what [Nights] counts before it is used for room nights or ADR?
options: Use [Nights] / [AVG Sale per Day] as room nights / ADR
Do not use them for room nights or ADR until confirmed
review.proposed: Do not use them for room nights or ADR until confirmed; answer owned-hotel room nights from Sales Per Owned Hotels [Total Room Nights] with the owned filter
review.why: Verified mismatch on 2025 data and on single bookings; presenting it as ADR would understate rates about threefold.
